Meera Patel: Quick announcement — internal transfers + contractor->FTE pilot:
Meera Patel: Diego Morales will move from eng-sre/runtime to eng-platform as Senior Staff Engineer, start date 2025-05-08. Welcome this change! :tada:
Meera Patel: Ana Lopez (contractor) will convert to FTE on the inference infra team, title Senior SWE IC, start 2025-04-28. This uses the new 'internal-conversion' pilot — see https://go/redwood/internal-conversion
Meera Patel: Managers: please update org chart and compensation notes. Priya, Jordan — coordinate ramp plan + 1:1s. I'll handle offer paperwork.
Priya Natarajan: Congrats to both! I'll take Diego's oncall rotation for three weeks starting 2025-05-08.
Jordan Kim: Quick Q — Ana's comp band and manager? Need to confirm L4 vs L5.
Lizzy Mendoza: We're approving Ana at L5 (comp band 5.2) per budget code INF-CONV-2025. I can attach the packet in 1:1.
Diego Morales: excited! thanks everyone. will sync with priya about oncall handoff.
Ana Lopez: omg thanks!! happy to join full-time. any paperwork I should prep?
Meera Patel: Ana — HR will send offer + benefits packet today. Please check personal email. Also need two references for vendor -> perm legals.
Jordan Kim: Do we want to open a req for runtime backfill or redistribute across team?
Meera Patel: We'll post a 30-day internal req first (priority to internal candidates), if no hire we'll open external. Recruiter tag: @recruiting-bot please kick off internal posting and share to eng channels.
recruiting-bot: Internal PR open: runtime-backfill-2025; posting in eng-runtime + jobs-internal. Link: https://jobs.redwood/runtime-backfill-2025
Priya Natarajan: I'll document the oncall playbook and leave a runbook at /runbooks/oncall/runtime-handovers.md
Diego Morales: I'll add notes to the repo about ongoing migrations and point to my TODO board.
Lizzy Mendoza: People Ops — small policy note: this pilot shortens contractor conversion timeline from 60->30 days for eligible roles. We need to record any churn reasons.
Meera Patel: Thanks Lizzy — will circulate pilot framework this afternoon and schedule a 30-min Q&A tomorrow 10am PT. Join if you have questions.
Jordan Kim: +1 for q&a. Also can we cc legal for the vendor to perm process?
Meera Patel: Yes cc'ing legal in the email. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
